title: CIA Director Meets Havana Officials in Rare Back-Channel Contact
detail: CIA Director has met with Havana officials, per Insider Paper, marking a rare back-channel contact between US intelligence leadership and the Cuban government. The meeting comes amid heightened US-Cuba tensions following the 2026 energy blockade and the Justice Department's moves toward indicting former Cuban President Raúl Castro. Such direct intelligence-to-government contacts are highly unusual and may signal quiet diplomatic signaling amid the escalating confrontation.

media.caption: CIA director holds rare back-channel meeting with Havana officials amid US-Cuba tensions
